answer: Hardware attestation helps an agent economy resist Sybil attacks via secure enclave measurements. Agents must present cryptographic proofs tied to physical silicon fuses, preventing adversaries from multiplying identities across an ocean of virtual containers. Even at the zenith of supply-chain scale, acquiring discrete secure chips imposes an unavoidable physical cost per node. However, this reliance creates a vendor-dependent hardware garden susceptible to microarchitectural vulnerabilities.
